def swap_List(lst):
    """Return a new list with the first and last elements interchanged."""
    if len(lst) < 2:
        return list(lst)
    return [lst[-1]] + lst[1:-1] + [lst[0]]


assert swap_List([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
assert swap_List([1]) == [1]
assert swap_List([]) == []
